title: Case: Duplicate delivery service charge appears on a business invoice
context: Two invoice lines have the same shipment, service and date. The authorised billing team must confirm duplication and issue a credit note and revised balance.
initial_request: Please ask billing to review the duplicate before we pay this invoice. We have not paid either line.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier's authorised billing team to review the two matching charge lines. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: A credit note is an accounting adjustment, not cash received. GBP 36.00 minus GBP 18.00 equals GBP 18.00 due.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please review INV-1713’s two GBP 18.00 lines for the same DL-2222 delivery service and date. If duplication is confirmed, issue the authorised credit and revised invoice balance.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-049: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
